title: Enforcement Rules of the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act
full_text:
■ Enforcement Rules of the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act [Attached Form No. 9-2] Statement of Supply of Tax-Exempt Fuel for Foreign-Going Vessels and Deep-Sea Fishing Vessels ※ Read the instructions on the reverse before completing this form. This form is distributed free of charge. Documents to be submitted: Data on the quantity of fuel supplied measured by a mass flow meter, or a Confirmation Note of Bunker Tank Sealing and Bunker Quantity. 210 mm × 297 mm [White paper, 80 g/m², or medium-grade paper, 80 g/m²] (Reverse) Instructions for Completion ※ In this statement, enter the contents of the certificate of loading of export articles eligible for refund received from the Korea Customs Service after supplying fuel to foreign-going vessels or deep-sea fishing vessels under Article 15 (1) 3 of the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act. 1. ① Resident (alien) registration number: Complete this field only for an individual who is not a business operator. 2. ② Category: Starting at the top of the first page of the statement, enter “01” for tax-exempt release under Article 15 of the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act and “02” for a credit (refund) under Article 17 of that Act. 3. ③ Date received: Enter the date of receipt shown on the certificate of loading of export articles eligible for refund. 4. ④ Entry/loading receipt number: Enter the receipt number shown on that certificate. 5. ⑤ Particulars of transferee: Enter particulars of the vessel that received the fuel. 6. ⑥ Item-field number: Enter the field number identifying the reported articles on the certificate of loading of export articles eligible for refund. 7. ⑦ Name of article: Enter the name of the loaded articles (enter the name of the articles for which a refund is sought, classified by the types of oil under the Act). 8. ⑧ Specifications: Enter the specification designation of the articles for which a refund is sought. 9. ⑨ Quantity: Enter the quantity of the relevant articles loaded. 10. ⑩ Tax amount: Enter ⑨ quantity × the tax rate (the tax rate under Article 2 of the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act). ■ Enforcement Rules of the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act [Attached Schedule to Attached Form No. 9-2] Confirmation of Sealing of 210 mm × 297 mm [White paper, 80 g/m², or medium-grade paper, 80 g/m²] (Reverse) Instructions for Completion 1. At shipment, seal all tanks and valves of the bunkering vessel, and then enter the unique seal number in each applicable field of the table. 2. At shipment, the person in charge from the refinery company must verify that the unique numbers are correct and then sign. However, where sealing is carried out again, such as when two or more receiving vessels are fueled during a single voyage, the refinery company's person in charge may verify the numbers after shipment. 3. At bunkering, before removing the seals and opening the valves, the persons in charge of the bunkering vessel and the receiving vessel must verify that the recorded unique numbers are correct. If the numbers entered in the form match the unique seal numbers, they must sign and then remove the seals. 210 mm × 297 mm [White paper, 80 g/m², or medium-grade paper, 80 g/m²]
